description: This file defines a helper class 'Log' that wraps Android's native logging utilities, providing static methods for different log levels and managing a chain of LogNodes for customizable log handling.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class that provides static methods for logging at various levels and manages a chain of LogNode objects for log processing.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the logging chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode that will handle log output.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Delegates a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and throwable to the current LogNode.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message with VERBOSE priority.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message with DEBUG priority.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message with INFO priority.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message with WARN priority.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message with ERROR priority.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT priority.
